## Problem and resulting change

Describe the trigger or reader problem and the behavior or wording after this
change. Link related public issues; explain scope and compatibility needs.

## Validation

List exact commands, runtime/revision, and outcomes. Explain skipped checks.
Distinguish local checks, completed CI, saved-record analysis, and new execution.

## Evidence and review

For numeric or capability claims, state the endpoint, provenance, uncertainty,
and limits. Public PRs need approved public evidence; keep private evidence in
the owning repository's approved internal review channels. Label synthetic
demonstrations, historical reports, and future plans. Confirm ownership when changing an
integration copy using approved internal records.

- [ ] I followed repository-specific contribution and validation guidance.
- [ ] Public additions contain no private repository names/code/findings,
      protected evaluations, gold answers, credentials, or raw/customer traces.
- [ ] I checked applicable licensing and preserved attribution.
- [ ] Any execution, publication, deployment, or settings change has separate
      authorization; this PR does not itself authorize those actions.
